svg.title: The serving engine's additions inside the engine
svg.desc: On the box, two calls beside 12 closed-loop agents, the calls' first token and their 16th token at p50 and p95, each the median of the runs, as the serving profile gained each addition it adopted, each row adding to the one before it but the announced turn's, which adds it to the kept prefixes in place of just in time, and the next, which has both: v1.14's serving profile, 2 runs: the first token 175 and 354 ms, the 16th 408 and 597 ms; + the calls' prefixes kept on the GPU, 2 runs: the first token 122 and 230 ms, the 16th 354 and 502 ms; + the next batch just in time, 2 runs: the first token 98 and 185 ms, the 16th 323 and 449 ms; or each turn announced, 2 runs: the first token 64 and 90 ms, the 16th 258 and 394 ms; + both, 1 run: the first token 63 and 98 ms, the 16th 257 and 403 ms; + the agents' reservations taken, 2 runs: the first token 64 and 92 ms, the 16th 261 and 392 ms; + their decodes held for 16 tokens, 2 runs: the first token 64 and 94 ms, the 16th 258 and 285 ms; + held for 48 tokens: the profile, 2 runs: the first token 66 and 88 ms, the 16th 257 and 284 ms.
svg.text: + the calls' prefixes kept on the GPU
+ the next batch just in time
